{{Quote|Diirn, we know you've been hoarding. That's why we let you think we store our food in here. It's too late, though&mdash;you're trapped. We're headed to the labs, to get what's ours. Your people can't stop us. Hope these are your last thoughts before the air runs out.|Xarval|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Diirn''' was the chief [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] of the ''[[Theoretika]]'', a [[research vessel]] operated by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. When the ''Theoretika'' became stranded in deep space, Vice Engineer [[Xarval]] eventually led a mutiny against Diirn, believing that Diirn was redirecting power to the labs in order to preserve hoarded food&mdash;but the power was actually to contain [[Specimen Gamma 19]]. Xarval trapped Diirn in one of the ''Theoretika''{{'s}} compartments and drained the air from the compartment, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Diirn, but by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the ''Theoretika'' was found, the rest of the crew was long dead as well.
